req.title: Task ids are monotonically increasing
req.statement: The system shall assign strictly increasing integer ids to newly created tasks.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that task IDs must be strictly increasing integers. This implies that each new task should have an ID greater than the previous one. The test suite will include a positive test to verify correct ID assignment, a negative test to check for non-increasing IDs, and a boundary test to ensure the system handles the transition from the highest existing ID correctly.

tests.name: test_create_task_id_increases
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Create a new task using POST /tasks/.
expected: The new task ID is greater than the highest existing task ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a new task
new_task = {"title": "New Task", "description": "Test task", "completed": False}
response = client.post("/tasks/", json=new_task)
assert response.status_code == 201
new_task_id = response.json()["id"]

# Verify the new task ID is greater than the highest existing ID
assert new_task_id > 20

tests.name: test_create_task_id_not_increasing
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Simulate a scenario where a new task is assigned an ID not greater than the highest existing ID.
expected: The system should not allow task creation with a non-increasing ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.database import get_db
from app.models import Task

client = TestClient(app)

def simulate_non_increasing_id():
    db: Session = next(get_db())
    # Manually insert a task with a lower ID
    task = Task(id=19, title="Invalid Task", description="Should not be allowed", completed=False)
    db.add(task)
    try:
        db.commit()
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()
        return False
    return True

assert not simulate_non_increasing_id()

tests.name: test_create_task_id_boundary
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Create a new task when the highest existing task ID is at the boundary.
expected: The new task ID should be exactly one greater than the highest existing task ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a new task
new_task = {"title": "Boundary Task", "description": "Boundary test", "completed": False}
response = client.post("/tasks/", json=new_task)
assert response.status_code == 201
new_task_id = response.json()["id"]

# Verify the new task ID is exactly one greater than the highest existing ID
assert new_task_id == 21
